newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise March rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise March rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday it was raising the margin requirements for its March rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The increase, which is aimed at cooling down overheated trade, will bring the total March requirement to 96,000 yen, it said in a statement.
The requirements on other rubber futures contracts will remain unchanged at 60,000 yen, it said.
